import math
a=math.sin(math.radians(31)); v=1/math.tan(math.radians(59))
opts={'A':a/math.sqrt(1-a*a),'B':a/math.sqrt(1+a*a),'C':math.sqrt(1+a*a)/a,'D':math.sqrt(1-a*a)/(2*a)}
assert abs(v-opts['A'])<1e-12
for k in 'BCD': assert abs(v-opts[k])>1e-3

from sympy import symbols, sin, cos, sec, cot, csc, solve, pi, sqrt, simplify, Interval, solveset, S
t=symbols('t')
sols=solveset(1/(1-sin(t))+1/(1+sin(t))-4*sec(t), t, Interval.open(0,pi/2))
sols=list(sols); assert len(sols)==1
v=simplify(cot(sols[0])+csc(sols[0]))
opts={'A':sqrt(6),'B':sqrt(5),'C':sqrt(2),'D':sqrt(3)}
assert simplify(v-opts['D'])==0
for k in 'ABC': assert simplify(v-opts[k])!=0
